changes.to: Robot.com (formerly Kiwibot) publishes no numbered specification sheet for this generation. Its current page for the successor R-Kiwi states Level 4 autonomy, 19 L cargo, a 12 h battery and six cameras with 3D LiDAR, which does not match these older figures. The recorded values come from campus-operator material: about 20.5 kg, 3-4 kg payload and 3.9 km/h, kept but not confirmed against a maker datasheet.
